'''Rone Mothin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[New Republic Army]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Rone Mothin was [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on [[Sheris]]. He defended the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces [[Battle of Sheris|attacked]] it during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="SWAJ9" />
